### Bible Pathways 04/09/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-04-or-09-or-2002-1133360.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:1
Points:
- Despite Samuel's monumental role as a spiritual giant and guide in Israel, Scripture records his passing in just one sentence.
- Although it appeared David and Saul urgently needed Samuel's ongoing counsel, God in His sovereign wisdom knew what was best.
- Human loss and bereavement bring profound grief, yet God promises tender comfort and presence to the brokenhearted.
- For the believer, death is not abandonment but an entrance into eternal life and a homecoming with the Lord.
